The neck is too long and narrow (star 85822 at (276,190)), which makes the body look like a bottle, not a squat jar.
The handle loop is a thin outline on the right (stars 113116 at (377,240) and 112519 at (398,232)). It is tucked too close to the shoulder, so it reads as a small hook rather than a loop handle.
